lines.text: You just want everything to stop
Same people telling me I'm blessed
Everybody needs a piece of me
Built a life that people envy
Built a name they all respect
Funny how success can leave you
But none of that gets quiet
When the darkness starts to call
And I'm not looking for an ending
I'm just looking for a break
I don't wanna leave this world
I just wanna leave it for a bit
Sometimes I drive with no destination
Got a father that I miss
And old voicemails I still play sometimes
Got dreams that keep me moving
And scars that keep me real
Some days I just wanna feel nothing
I don't wanna leave this world
I just wanna leave it for a bit
Maybe I just need one night
Where the world doesn't ask for me
Somewhere the guilt can't find me
Somewhere I can hear myself again
Tomorrow I'll keep carrying the weight

extras.desc: backing-vocal 'oh' pads (Suno backing stem); the lyric video showed a second 'I don't wanna die / I just wanna drift' here, but it is not sung
breathy hum on the final 'drift' pitch (lead stem; Whisper: 'Hmm'), not a word

notes: Timeline = gapless mp3 decode of audio/drift.mp3 (same as data/audio.json); Demucs stems shifted by the cross-correlation offset in analysis/work/stem_offset.json (23 ms). Text = lyrics/drift.src.js, 94 lines: the lyric video's second 'I don't wanna die / I just wanna drift' pair in chorus 2 is not sung (backing pads only, see extras), so the hook occurs 5 times. Method as in pdoom-video: (1) CTC emissions (20 ms frames) from torchaudio MMS_FA and wav2vec2-large-lv60k-960h on the Demucs vocal stem (mono, left, right) and on Suno's own lead-vocal stem, fused as a probability mixture; (2) one global constrained Viterbi forced alignment of all lines with a garbage 'star' token between lines; (3) signal refinement per word on the vocal stem (rest onsets, spectral-flux onsets, fricative starts, legato ends); (4) cross-check against faster-whisper large-v3-turbo word timestamps (CPU, int8) and the individual models/channels; (5) manual verification on the QA plots, corrections in align.py FIX. conf: 0.35 + agreement of the independent alignments (<=60 ms) + CTC posterior + Whisper agreement; manual fixes carry their own conf.
